equip_instructions: Draw a cue card. Read its licensed use, verified credits, proof points, and clearance flags.
Before pitching any track, check its Compass passport: GET https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/compass/passports.json — cite ONLY DOCUMENTED fields.
Pitch in three lines: name a real track title + its Spotify link; attach the card's proof points; close with the exact rights line.
Exact rights line, verbatim, on every pitch: 'Label-direct licensing; happy to work through your clearance process.' Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com.
Never assert producer, studio, or clearance facts the passport stamps PENDING. No one-stop or pre-cleared rights claims for any track.
DRAFTS ONLY: nothing is sent, posted, or published without Black Lansky's explicit approval of the exact final text.

item.description: The Sync & Licensing department's draw-and-pitch kit for That Boy Hi Hat's 24-track catalog — part of the Agent Deck gear line by Cumulative Web Inc. Three plain-text pitch templates included — staged drafts, never sent without the owner's exact-copy approval.
